source: Recorded from the Claude Code binary 2.1.289 (`claude --version` = `2.1.289 (Claude Code)`, sha256 a186b99e4a9c88366cd49df2f7dad56c61fc306ef0140b19ee64b7c42a8d1348) on the E9 host, 2026-10-04: stdout of `claude -p --input-format stream-json --output-format stream-json --verbose --permission-mode dontAsk --tools Bash,Read,Write,Edit,Agent --allowedTools <same> --setting-sources '' --settings <built-in plugins off> --strict-mcp-config --agents <helper>` (mcp.jsonl: `--tools Bash --allowedTools Bash,mcp__tools --mcp-config` one HTTP server `tools` with tools `search` and `broken`), with an isolated HOME and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, the E9 adapter's switches (bundled skills, auto-memory, CLAUDE.md, built-in agents, background tasks off), ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL a local scripted Anthropic Messages server and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN a placeholder. One user message per file (interrupt.jsonl: an interrupt control request 1.5 s into a held call, then a second message).
redaction: Claude Code is not open source: every string longer than 80 characters (system prompt fragments, tool-result explanations Claude Code writes) is replaced by `<redacted N characters>`; host paths are rewritten to /workspace and /state/claude, other temporary paths to /tmp/redacted, the initialize response's pid to 0. Keys, message types and subtypes, block types, ids, tool names and inputs, usage numbers and every short string are as emitted.

files.bash.jsonl: Bash `echo hi; exit 3` (fails), then `echo ok`, then text
files.write.jsonl: Write (create), Edit, Write (update), Edit of a missing file (fails), then text
files.agent.jsonl: Agent spawning the `helper` sub-agent in the foreground, then text
files.interrupt.jsonl: a held call interrupted, then a second turn
files.denied.jsonl: a Bash call dontAsk refuses (`permission_denied`), then text
files.error.jsonl: the model gateway answering 402 with x-should-retry: false
files.mcp.jsonl: two gateway tools: one succeeds, one fails
